label: Short text
description: A single line of plain text up to 500 characters, such as a title, a vendor name, a serial number, or an external reference. Use long_text for multi-line notes and rich_text for formatted content.
usage: Use for names, codes, and references that fit on one line.
Set maxLength to the real-world limit (e.g. 80 for a vendor name).
Use pattern with a patternMessage for formats like asset tags ("^AT-[0-9]{6}$").
For numbers people will compare or sum, use integer or decimal instead.
constraints: pattern must be a valid regular expression; it runs with a 50 ms timeout and no backtracking.
Values are trimmed; an empty string is stored as null.

unique.description: Unique among records of the entity in this tenant environment.

accessibility.keyboard: Standard text input. Esc reverts an inline edit; Enter commits.
